subject: science
domain: Waves and Their Applications in Technologies for Information Transfer

items.prompt:
A digital signal uses
A) patterns of two values like 0 and 1
B) a smoothly varying range
C) only colors
D) only sounds
items.answer: A) patterns of two values like 0 and 1

items.prompt:
An analog signal
A) varies smoothly over a range
B) uses only 0 and 1
C) cannot carry information
D) is always digital
items.answer: A) varies smoothly over a range

items.prompt:
A digital signal can be copied
A) exactly, without losing quality
B) only once
C) never
D) with heavy quality loss

Digital signals resist noise better because
A) small noise usually does not change which of the two values it is
B) they have no values
C) noise helps them
D) they vary smoothly
items.answer: A) small noise usually does not change which of the two values it is

steps: Two distinct values resist small noise.

items.prompt:
Music today is usually stored
A) digitally
B) only on records
C) only as analog
D) not at all

Which is an advantage of digital over analog?
A) Exact copying without quality loss
B) It cannot be copied
C) It degrades faster
D) It is more affected by noise
items.answer: A) Exact copying without quality loss

steps: Digital copies exactly and resists noise.

items.prompt:
Evaluate: 'Analog is always better than digital for sending information.' This is
A) wrong, because digital usually has advantages like exact copying and noise resistance
B) always true
C) proof analog has no flaws
D) about taste only
items.answer: A) wrong, because digital usually has advantages like exact copying and noise resistance

items.prompt:
Error correction is easier with digital signals because
A) the distinct values make errors easy to detect and fix
B) analog has no errors
C) digital cannot have errors
D) errors are ignored
items.answer: A) the distinct values make errors easy to detect and fix
